nodes.name: DocumentContextSelectionPanel.tsx
nodes.summary: Presentational panel that renders the whole-document context picker: a header with a live selected count, a scrollable list of documents with per-status affordances, an empty state, and cancel/confirm actions. It holds no state of its own and drives everything through the injected DocumentMultiSelectionController.
nodes.languageNotes: Fully controlled React component: every value and handler comes from a single controller prop, so the panel stays free of local state and can be tested by passing a plain object.

nodes.name: DocumentSelectionRow
nodes.summary: Renders one document as a checkbox-role button showing title, processing status label, and a status explanation, choosing icon and palette from the document's processing status. Only ready documents are enabled; processing and failed rows are disabled and non-toggleable.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses role="checkbox" with aria-checked, aria-disabled, and aria-describedby so the selection state and the reason a row is unavailable are both announced by screen readers.

nodes.name: DocumentContextSelectionPanel
nodes.summary: Exported panel component composing the instruction header, aria-live selected count, document list or empty state, and the cancel/confirm footer. The confirm button is disabled when nothing is selected unless the controller allows an empty selection.

nodes.name: documentContextSelectionTypes.ts
nodes.summary: Declares the typed port for whole-document context selection: the DocumentContextSource metadata projection, the DocumentMultiSelection request a consuming feature supplies, its result payload, and the DocumentMultiSelectionController the panel renders against.
nodes.languageNotes: DocumentContextSource is a Pick over the shared DocumentSummary contract, deliberately exposing only metadata so processed document bodies stay behind the server-side context-source reader.

nodes.name: useDocumentMultiSelection.ts
nodes.summary: Hook owning the tentative whole-document selection state so choices survive panel switches, exposing a controller with normalized documents, toggling restricted to ready same-project records, and one-shot cancel/confirm outcomes. Also wires Escape-to-cancel and resets state when the selection request appears or disappears.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses refs (wasActiveRef, outcomeCompletedRef) as latch flags rather than shadow state: they gate the activation reset and guarantee onConfirm/onCancel fire at most once per selection session without triggering re-renders.

nodes.name: normalizeDocuments
nodes.summary: Filters incoming documents down to trusted selectable records: trims id and title, drops entries from another project or with blank fields or an unrecognized processing status, and de-duplicates by id keeping the last occurrence in first-seen order.

nodes.name: normalizeInitialIds
nodes.summary: Normalizes a caller-supplied list of pre-selected document ids by trimming, discarding empty strings, and removing duplicates, returning an empty array when no ids were provided.

nodes.name: useDocumentMultiSelection
nodes.summary: Exported hook that turns a nullable DocumentMultiSelection request plus a document list into a stable controller, memoizing normalized documents, ready ids, and the active selection set. Confirm reports only currently ready documents and is suppressed on an empty selection unless the request allows it.
nodes.languageNotes: Selection is derived, not stored: raw selectedDocumentIds are intersected with readyDocumentIds on every render, so a document that stops being ready silently drops out of the effective selection instead of leaking into confirm.
